test_title: PYST 48 - SSC CHSL 2025 - English Language (Held On: 30 Nov, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
Choose the option that is the most appropriate conversion of the following sentence into Direct Speech.

They asked whether the meeting was likely to begin soon or be delayed further.

options.text: They asked, "Was the meeting likely to begin soon or be delayed further?"
They asked, "Is the meeting likely to begin shortly or be delayed more?"
They asked, "Will the meeting likely begin soon or is it to be delayed further?"
They asked, "Is the meeting likely to begin soon or will it be delayed further?"

solution:
The correct answer is '4' i.e. Is the meeting likely to begin soon or will it be delayed further? .

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence is in **Indirect Speech**, where the speaker reports a question about whether the meeting will begin soon or be delayed further.
 
• To convert it into **Direct Speech**, we need to use the exact phrasing of the question, maintaining the correct tense and grammar.
 
• In **Direct Speech**, questions are framed using the auxiliary verb at the beginning of the sentence (e.g., *Is*, *Will*).

Correct conversion: *They asked, "Is the meeting likely to begin soon or will it be delayed further?"*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Explanation of other options:**
 
 
• **Option 1:** Incorrect because "Was" is used, which is past tense, while the original sentence is in present/future tense.
 
• **Option 2:** Incorrect because "shortly" and "more" alter the meaning of the original sentence.
 
• **Option 3:** Incorrect because "Will the meeting likely begin" is grammatically awkward and not standard usage.
